facts.fact: Most cleaning businesses convert 30-55% of quote requests to first-job bookings, according to the Adwave guide.
facts.quote: Most cleaning businesses convert 30-55% of quote requests to first-job bookings, so the top of the funnel needs steady volume.

facts.fact: The guide states that the choice of cleaning provider is often made within 48-72 hours of the triggering event.
facts.quote: the choice of provider is often made within 48-72 hours of the trigger.

facts.fact: According to the Adwave guide, a one-time deep clean is worth $200-$500.
facts.quote: a one-time deep clean is worth $200-$500; a converted weekly residential client is worth $3,000-$8,000/year

facts.fact: According to the Adwave guide, a converted weekly residential cleaning client is worth $3,000-$8,000 per year.
facts.quote: a converted weekly residential client is worth $3,000-$8,000/year

facts.fact: According to the Adwave guide, a commercial janitorial contract is worth $12,000-$80,000+ per year.
facts.quote: a commercial janitorial contract is worth $12,000-$80,000+/year.

facts.fact: In the Adwave guide's 2026 estimates, Google Ads cost per quote request is $25-$95 for residential cleaning.
facts.quote: Cost per quote request: $25-$95 for residential cleaning, $40-$180 for commercial janitorial.

facts.fact: In the Adwave guide's 2026 estimates, Meta Ads cost per quote request is $40-$120 for residential cleaning.
facts.quote: Cost per quote request: $40-$120 for residential, $60-$200 for commercial.

facts.quote: first-touch Meta visitors often need 3-7 touches before converting.

facts.fact: The Adwave guide estimates direct-attribution CTV cost per quote request at $80-$220 for residential cleaning.

facts.fact: With cross-channel lift included, the Adwave guide estimates CTV cost per quote request at $50-$140 for residential cleaning.
facts.quote: With cross-channel lift included: $50-$140 for residential, $80-$220 for commercial.

facts.fact: The Adwave guide recommends a CTV frequency target of 3-5 impressions per household over 2-3 week flights.
facts.quote: Frequency target of 3-5 per household over 2-3 week flights.

facts.quote: Adwave starts at $30 a day

facts.quote: For residential cleaning businesses with monthly ad budgets of $1,800+

facts.fact: The Adwave guide says CTV is best for cleaning businesses with 12+ months of operating history serving a defined geography.
facts.quote: cleaning businesses with 12+ months of operating history serving a defined geography

facts.fact: The Adwave guide estimates local SEO and Google Business Profile costs at $0-$500 per month in tools and time.

facts.fact: The Adwave guide estimates direct mail and door hanger cost per quote request at $35-$150 for well-targeted residential mail.

facts.fact: Yelp paid placement for cleaning categories runs $300-$2,500 per month depending on market, according to the page.
facts.quote: Yelp paid placement runs $300-$2,500/month for cleaning categories depending on market.

facts.fact: Meta Ads cost per quote for cleaning businesses is listed at $40-$200 in the page's channel comparison table.
facts.quote: Meta Ads (FB + IG) | Top to mid | $40-$200 | Residential cleaning | 60-120 days

facts.fact: For a solo or new cleaning business under 25 clients, the page recommends Google Ads at $400-$1,000 per month.
facts.quote: Google Ads (Search + LSA): $400-$1,000/month

facts.fact: For a solo or new cleaning business under 25 clients, the page recommends a total monthly ad budget of $1,000-$2,300.
facts.quote: Total recommended monthly ad budget: $1,000-$2,300. Goal: 15-35 quote requests per month.

facts.fact: For a growing residential business with 25-100 active clients, the page recommends CTV spend of $1,500-$2,500 per month as a starting point.
facts.quote: CTV: $1,500-$2,500/month (recommended starting point)

facts.fact: For a growing residential business with 25-100 active clients, the page recommends a total monthly ad budget of $3,300-$7,100.
facts.quote: Total recommended monthly ad budget: $3,300-$7,100. Goal: 40-90 quote requests per month

facts.fact: For an established residential or commercial business with 100+ active clients, the page recommends a total monthly ad budget of $7,500-$17,000.
facts.quote: Total recommended monthly ad budget: $7,500-$17,000.

facts.fact: For an established business with 100+ clients, the page recommends CTV spend of $2,500-$5,000 per month with a multi-market emphasis.
facts.quote: CTV: $2,500-$5,000/month, multi-market emphasis

facts.fact: The page recommends LinkedIn Ads spend of $600-$1,500 per month for commercial-heavy cleaning businesses.
facts.quote: LinkedIn Ads ($600-$1,500/month) for B2B targeting

facts.fact: The page states Google Ads and Local Services Ads typically take 30-45 days to produce measurable quote volume.
facts.quote: For Google Ads and Local Services Ads, expect 30-45 days for measurable quote volume. For Meta, 60-120 days.

facts.fact: The page states Meta Ads typically take 60-120 days to produce measurable quote volume.
facts.quote: For Meta, 60-120 days. For CTV, 60-90 days.

facts.fact: The page says residential cleaning businesses with 6+ months of operating history and at least 15-25 strong reviews are best suited for reviews platforms.
facts.quote: Best for: residential cleaning businesses with 6+ months of operating history and at least 15-25 strong reviews.

facts.fact: The page advises building 10-20 referral sources in your area as part of an industry partnership setup.
facts.quote: identify 10-20 referral sources in your area.

facts.fact: The page states that in markets where Yelp drives meaningful traffic, paid placement can produce ROI with at least 20-30 strong reviews.
facts.quote: you have at least 20-30 strong reviews, paid placement can produce real ROI.

facts.fact: The page says cleaning businesses testing CTV typically use monthly budgets of $1,500-$2,500, with subscription-tier platforms bringing CTV access into a $50-$500 entry range.
facts.quote: Subscription-tier platforms have brought CTV access to the $50-$500 entry range

facts.fact: The page recommends tracking long-term ROI as 12-month gross revenue per client divided by 12-month total ad spend (lifetime ROAS).
facts.quote: Long-term: 12-month gross revenue per client divided by 12-month total ad spend (lifetime ROAS).

facts.fact: The page gives a hypothetical example in which a channel producing 30 quotes converts to 5 one-time jobs, which it calls worse than a channel producing 12 quotes that converts to 6 recurring weekly clients.
facts.value: 30 quotes to 5 one-time jobs; 12 quotes to 6 recurring weekly clients
facts.quote: A channel that produces 30 quotes that convert to 5 one-time jobs is worse than a channel that produces 12 quotes that convert to 6 recurring weekly clients.

facts.fact: The page recommends that early-stage cleaning businesses start with partnerships with 5-10 local referral sources as part of their foundation channels.
facts.quote: partnerships with 5-10 local referral sources

facts.fact: The page states that the cleaning businesses growing fastest in 2026 run a coordinated mix of channels rather than a single channel.
facts.quote: The cleaning businesses growing fastest in 2026 don't run a single channel.
